prompt.alinti: You can turn Claude into an insane AI designer with five free tools.
First, taste skill. It gives Claude actual design rules to follow, so your site stops screaming, AI made this.
Second, impeccable. It upgrades your front end with its own design system, plus a live editor to tweak things right in your browser.
Third, playwright CLI. Claude spins up browsers, tests your site, and takes screenshots to check everything works.
Fourth, awesome design. It gives Claude design systems from real websites — the typography, spacing, buttons, and layouts.
And the last one, image23js. Drop in an image of a bike, and Claude rebuilds it as an interactive 3D model through code.

yontem.alinti: It gives Claude design systems from real websites — the typography, spacing, buttons, and layouts.

yontem.alinti: Drop in an image of a bike, and Claude rebuilds it as an interactive 3D model through code.
